programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage. Siu shockingly finds out Alex is a mirage! Welcome to the 1960s and Coco (Selena Lee) is a hostess at Twilight Ballroom. She dreams of becoming an air hostess someday. She falls in love with Lau Yuk-fai (Joel Chan), who is a policeman and a dead ringer for some guy in her dream. Her fantastic dream is even adapted as a novel by bookstore owner Lam Yeuk-sze (Bob Cheung). Siu accidentally finds this novel from yesteryear as he just has to get to the bottom of the mystery. Siu is aghast when he finds out he and Alex had been destined to get intertwined in some previous life.

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN's bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG's lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI's (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne of MAN. FUNG loses his memory on a mission and has turned from a cruel person into a man with sympathy. PRINCESS WING-YEUNG (Elanne Kwong) never likes brocade guards. She tells PO, a good friend of hers, to guard against FUNG. MAN still thinks very highly of FUNG, but FUNG has become distrustful since his accident. And for reason he does not know, he finds the mysterious SHUM TSIN-SAM (Kate Tsui) and TAI, who is a deep person, very familiar. Later when he comes to know a secret on a mission to kill TAI, he is caught in a dilemma of feeling angry and guilty.

programme.title: Line Walker
programme.desc: Following the death of his co-worker, CHEUK HOI (Michael Mui) discovers that five undercover officers have lost. All of them possess confidential information. CHEUK HOI needs to find them immediately……

programme.title: Line Walker
programme.desc: Following the death of his co-worker, CHEUK HOI (Michael Mui) discovers that five undercover officers have lost. All of them possess confidential information. CHEUK HOI needs to find them immediately……

programme.title: Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUNG (So Yuk Wa, Louisa) to control TIGER and misleads LEUNG that TIGER is her long lost rescuer. Using tricks to upset TIGER, he makes TIGER marry LEUNG. Since then, LEUNG tries every means to domesticate her husband and that almost drives him insane. BUN is relieved to escape from TIGER's manipulation but he carelessly causes lots of troubles elsewhere… “A Bride for A Ride” brings you a modern perspective of this traditional tale and you'll surely be surprised with its astonishing approach.

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the company brings in MAN NIM-SUM (Frankie Lam), a marketing visionary, to be her equal! Thus begins the power struggle fueled by hatred and ego between the ex-couple. LING MAN handpicks a beautiful trainee from Shanghai called TIAN MI (Samantha Ko), who knows her way around men, to spy on NIM-SUM, without knowing that TIAN MI covets not only her job but also her man, triggering another cut-throat competition! On the other hand, YU-KEN uncovers the affair of her philandering boyfriend HO CHI-CHIU (Lai Lok Yi). Feeling downhearted and blue, she encounters the most caring guy named CHING YAT-FAI (Vincent Wong). Thinking their relationship will blossom into love, she surprisingly finds out that YAT-FAI's sweet and feminine cousin from Taiwan confesses her affection to him. YU-KEN's effort instantly pales in comparison with hers! To make matters worse, YAT-FAI seems to have suffered from gamophobia, rendering YU-KEN hopeless of getting married. Can these two dominant ladies devoid of femininity turn the tide to find their “Happily Ever After”?

programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his eyes. According to BAO ZHENG's investigation, SEUNG-SEUNG was actually a princess, but was instead framed by a villain, GAO JIAN (Ben Wong). Shedding his tears, BAO ZHENG is forced to execute SEUNG-SEUNG, triggering his soul to once again float out of his body to the 1950s, when he becomes an all-powerful inspector WAH LUNG-BIU (Bobby Au Yeung). As predestined, he believes he will re-encounter TSIK-SUET, yet TIN TSAU-FUNG (Esther Kwan), who is standing in front of him, does not recall him at all. On the contrary, she thinks he is the one who killed her husband. In order to change his fate, LUNG-BIU continuously verifies the truth. Unexpectedly, he learns that a dancer, LAM YIM-FONG (Rebecca Zhu) and her boyfriend YUEN KWAI (Pierre Ngo), are his biological parents. Moreover, TIN TSAU-FUNG's younger sister TIN TSAU-NGAN (Mandy Wong) turns out to be manipulating the whole plot. Tragedy recurs when LUNG-BIU accidentally kills TSAU-FUNG again. With KAM-CHEONG's soul returning to the modern era, he is determined to ferret out the one who has cast the spell on him in the cycle of reincarnation so as to protect TSIK-SUET as well as to escape from the curse. However, to his surprise, it is him initiating all these tragedies......

Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his eyes. According to BAO ZHENG's investigation, SEUNG-SEUNG was actually a princess, but was instead framed by a villain, GAO JIAN (Ben Wong). Shedding his tears, BAO ZHENG is forced to execute SEUNG-SEUNG, triggering his soul to once again float out of his body to the 1950s, when he becomes an all-powerful inspector WAH LUNG-BIU (Bobby Au Yeung). As predestined, he believes he will re-encounter TSIK-SUET, yet TIN TSAU-FUNG (Esther Kwan), who is standing in front of him, does not recall him at all. On the contrary, she thinks he is the one who killed her husband. In order to change his fate, LUNG-BIU continuously verifies the truth. Unexpectedly, he learns that a dancer, LAM YIM-FONG (Rebecca Zhu) and her boyfriend YUEN KWAI (Pierre Ngo), are his biological parents. Moreover, TIN TSAU-FUNG's younger sister TIN TSAU-NGAN (Mandy Wong) turns out to be manipulating the whole plot. Tragedy recurs when LUNG-BIU accidentally kills TSAU-FUNG again. With KAM-CHEONG's soul returning to the modern era, he is determined to ferret out the one who has cast the spell on him in the cycle of reincarnation so as to protect TSIK-SUET as well as to escape from the curse. However, to his surprise, it is him initiating all these tragedies......

programme.title: Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUNG (So Yuk Wa, Louisa) to control TIGER and misleads LEUNG that TIGER is her long lost rescuer. Using tricks to upset TIGER, he makes TIGER marry LEUNG. Since then, LEUNG tries every means to domesticate her husband and that almost drives him insane. BUN is relieved to escape from TIGER's manipulation but he carelessly causes lots of troubles elsewhere… “A Bride for A Ride” brings you a modern perspective of this traditional tale and you'll surely be surprised with its astonishing approach.

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the company brings in MAN NIM-SUM (Frankie Lam), a marketing visionary, to be her equal! Thus begins the power struggle fueled by hatred and ego between the ex-couple. LING MAN handpicks a beautiful trainee from Shanghai called TIAN MI (Samantha Ko), who knows her way around men, to spy on NIM-SUM, without knowing that TIAN MI covets not only her job but also her man, triggering another cut-throat competition! On the other hand, YU-KEN uncovers the affair of her philandering boyfriend HO CHI-CHIU (Lai Lok Yi). Feeling downhearted and blue, she encounters the most caring guy named CHING YAT-FAI (Vincent Wong). Thinking their relationship will blossom into love, she surprisingly finds out that YAT-FAI's sweet and feminine cousin from Taiwan confesses her affection to him. YU-KEN's effort instantly pales in comparison with hers! To make matters worse, YAT-FAI seems to have suffered from gamophobia, rendering YU-KEN hopeless of getting married. Can these two dominant ladies devoid of femininity turn the tide to find their “Happily Ever After”?

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage. Siu shockingly finds out Alex is a mirage! Welcome to the 1960s and Coco (Selena Lee) is a hostess at Twilight Ballroom. She dreams of becoming an air hostess someday. She falls in love with Lau Yuk-fai (Joel Chan), who is a policeman and a dead ringer for some guy in her dream. Her fantastic dream is even adapted as a novel by bookstore owner Lam Yeuk-sze (Bob Cheung). Siu accidentally finds this novel from yesteryear as he just has to get to the bottom of the mystery. Siu is aghast when he finds out he and Alex had been destined to get intertwined in some previous life.

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN's bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG's lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI's (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne of MAN. FUNG loses his memory on a mission and has turned from a cruel person into a man with sympathy. PRINCESS WING-YEUNG (Elanne Kwong) never likes brocade guards. She tells PO, a good friend of hers, to guard against FUNG. MAN still thinks very highly of FUNG, but FUNG has become distrustful since his accident. And for reason he does not know, he finds the mysterious SHUM TSIN-SAM (Kate Tsui) and TAI, who is a deep person, very familiar. Later when he comes to know a secret on a mission to kill TAI, he is caught in a dilemma of feeling angry and guilty.

On the other hand, YU-KEN uncovers the affair of her philandering boyfriend HO CHI-CHIU (Lai Lok Yi). Feeling downhearted and blue, she encounters the most caring guy named CHING YAT-FAI (Vincent Wong). Thinking their relationship will blossom into love, she surprisingly finds out that YAT-FAI's sweet and feminine cousin from Taiwan confesses her affection to him. YU-KEN's effort instantly pales in comparison with hers! To make matters worse, YAT-FAI seems to have suffered from gamophobia, rendering YU-KEN hopeless of getting married. Can these two dominant ladies devoid of femininity turn the tide to find their “Happily Ever After”?

programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. She falls in love with Lau Yuk-fai (Joel Chan), who is a policeman and a dead ringer for some guy in her dream. programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne of MAN. FUNG loses his memory on a mission and has turned from a cruel person into a man with sympathy. PRINCESS WING-YEUNG (Elanne Kwong) never likes brocade guards. She tells PO, a good friend of hers, to guard against FUNG. MAN still thinks very highly of FUNG, but FUNG has become distrustful since his accident. And for reason he does not know, he finds the mysterious SHUM TSIN-SAM (Kate Tsui) and TAI, who is a deep person, very familiar. programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his eyes. According to BAO ZHENG's investigation, SEUNG-SEUNG was actually a princess, but was instead framed by a villain, GAO JIAN (Ben Wong). Shedding his tears, BAO ZHENG is forced to execute SEUNG-SEUNG, triggering his soul to once again float out of his body to the 1950s, when he becomes an all-powerful inspector WAH LUNG-BIU (Bobby Au Yeung). As predestined, he believes he will re-encounter TSIK-SUET, yet TIN TSAU-FUNG (Esther Kwan), who is standing in front of him, does not recall him at all. On the contrary, she thinks he is the one who killed her husband. In order to change his fate, LUNG-BIU continuously verifies the truth. Unexpectedly, he learns that a dancer, LAM YIM-FONG (Rebecca Zhu) and her boyfriend YUEN KWAI (Pierre Ngo), are his biological parents. Moreover, TIN TSAU-FUNG's younger sister TIN TSAU-NGAN (Mandy Wong) turns out to be manipulating the whole plot. Tragedy recurs when LUNG-BIU accidentally kills TSAU-FUNG again. With KAM-CHEONG's soul returning to the modern era, he is determined to ferret out the one who has cast the spell on him in the cycle of reincarnation so as to protect TSIK-SUET as well as to escape from the curse. However, to his surprise, it is him initiating all these tragedies......

programme.title: Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUNG (So Yuk Wa, Louisa) to control TIGER and misleads LEUNG that TIGER is her long lost rescuer. Using tricks to upset TIGER, he makes TIGER marry LEUNG. Since then, LEUNG tries every means to domesticate her husband and that almost drives him insane. BUN is relieved to escape from TIGER's manipulation but he carelessly causes lots of troubles elsewhere… “A Bride for A Ride” brings you a modern perspective of this traditional tale and you'll surely be surprised with its astonishing approach.

Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his eyes. According to BAO ZHENG's investigation, SEUNG-SEUNG was actually a princess, but was instead framed by a villain, GAO JIAN (Ben Wong). Shedding his tears, BAO ZHENG is forced to execute SEUNG-SEUNG, triggering his soul to once again float out of his body to the 1950s, when he becomes an all-powerful inspector WAH LUNG-BIU (Bobby Au Yeung). As predestined, he believes he will re-encounter TSIK-SUET, yet TIN TSAU-FUNG (Esther Kwan), who is standing in front of him, does not recall him at all. On the contrary, she thinks he is the one who killed her husband. In order to change his fate, LUNG-BIU continuously verifies the truth. Unexpectedly, he learns that a dancer, LAM YIM-FONG (Rebecca Zhu) and her boyfriend YUEN KWAI (Pierre Ngo), are his biological parents. Moreover, TIN TSAU-FUNG's younger sister TIN TSAU-NGAN (Mandy Wong) turns out to be manipulating the whole plot. Tragedy recurs when LUNG-BIU accidentally kills TSAU-FUNG again. With KAM-CHEONG's soul returning to the modern era, he is determined to ferret out the one who has cast the spell on him in the cycle of reincarnation so as to protect TSIK-SUET as well as to escape from the curse. However, to his surprise, it is him initiating all these tragedies......

programme.title: Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUNG (So Yuk Wa, Louisa) to control TIGER and misleads LEUNG that TIGER is her long lost rescuer. Using tricks to upset TIGER, he makes TIGER marry LEUNG. Since then, LEUNG tries every means to domesticate her husband and that almost drives him insane. BUN is relieved to escape from TIGER's manipulation but he carelessly causes lots of troubles elsewhere… “A Bride for A Ride” brings you a modern perspective of this traditional tale and you'll surely be surprised with its astonishing approach.

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the company brings in MAN NIM-SUM (Frankie Lam), a marketing visionary, to be her equal! Thus begins the power struggle fueled by hatred and ego between the ex-couple. LING MAN handpicks a beautiful trainee from Shanghai called TIAN MI (Samantha Ko), who knows her way around men, to spy on NIM-SUM, without knowing that TIAN MI covets not only her job but also her man, triggering another cut-throat competition! On the other hand, YU-KEN uncovers the affair of her philandering boyfriend HO CHI-CHIU (Lai Lok Yi). Feeling downhearted and blue, she encounters the most caring guy named CHING YAT-FAI (Vincent Wong). Thinking their relationship will blossom into love, she surprisingly finds out that YAT-FAI's sweet and feminine cousin from Taiwan confesses her affection to him. YU-KEN's effort instantly pales in comparison with hers! To make matters worse, YAT-FAI seems to have suffered from gamophobia, rendering YU-KEN hopeless of getting married. Can these two dominant ladies devoid of femininity turn the tide to find their “Happily Ever After”?

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage. Siu shockingly finds out Alex is a mirage! Welcome to the 1960s and Coco (Selena Lee) is a hostess at Twilight Ballroom. She dreams of becoming an air hostess someday. She falls in love with Lau Yuk-fai (Joel Chan), who is a policeman and a dead ringer for some guy in her dream. Her fantastic dream is even adapted as a novel by bookstore owner Lam Yeuk-sze (Bob Cheung). Siu accidentally finds this novel from yesteryear as he just has to get to the bottom of the mystery. Siu is aghast when he finds out he and Alex had been destined to get intertwined in some previous life.

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN's bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG's lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI's (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne of MAN. FUNG loses his memory on a mission and has turned from a cruel person into a man with sympathy. PRINCESS WING-YEUNG (Elanne Kwong) never likes brocade guards. She tells PO, a good friend of hers, to guard against FUNG. MAN still thinks very highly of FUNG, but FUNG has become distrustful since his accident. And for reason he does not know, he finds the mysterious SHUM TSIN-SAM (Kate Tsui) and TAI, who is a deep person, very familiar. Later when he comes to know a secret on a mission to kill TAI, he is caught in a dilemma of feeling angry and guilty.

programme.title: Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: Ever since his childhood, KO TIN-PO (Wong Cho Lam) has tasted a variety of great delicacies, and he is capable of analyzing the food quality and authenticity once he tastes it. But, owing to the decline of his family, he ends up wandering on the street with his servant LEE WAI (Jack Wu), making a living from selling buns. Also due to his gourmet background, he gets to know a street performer KEI MO-SUET (Joey Meng), the most beautiful girl in Peking NIAN RUOBI (Nancy Wu) and teen celebrity chef MAI SIU-YU (Stephanie Ho), etc. As fate would have it, he comes across Prince YINZHEN (Ben Wong), who is making a tour in disguise, and the two share similar interests. Later on, he is recommended for an imperial chef in the palace, where he runs into his archrival CHOI HOK-TING (Bob Lam), resulting in consecutive fierce battles between them. Meanwhile, TIN-PO has no idea he has been caught in the plot that Prince YINSI (Louis Cheung) hatches to become the rightful heir to the throne. Under such disadvantage, TIN-PO becomes the man who brings luck to Prince YINZHEN, continuously turning the tide for him before his defeat. However, an unexpected betrothal brings him down from the lofty position to the most inferior one of a stray dog......

programme.title: Offliners, The
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, investing in finance, real estate and commerce are down-to-earth activities, but rich heiress WONG CHI-FEI (Katy Kung) prefers getting her head in the clouds, cofounding a start-up technology company with her best friend HUI CHING-WAI (Jason Chan). A network hacking incident allows CHI-FEI to have a chance to know how capable IT genius DING SHUN-HEI (Owen Cheung) is, so she invites him to join the company. SHUN-HEI is a geek and oblivious of his surroundings. He gets help from a nurse named CHEUNG LOI (Moon Lau) and overcomes his communication barriers. Gradually, he grows fond of her. Despite initial disagreements, CHI-FEI and SHUN-HEI become more cooperative and are even complementary to each other. Inadvertently, CHI-FEI develops feelings for SHUN-HEI…… Originally, CHI-FEI believes that technology is making the world a better place, however, her father WONG SAU-KEN (Joseph Lee), younger brother WONG CHI-LUNG (Marcus Lo) and SHUN-HEI's younger sister DING SHUN-YAN (Jacqueline Wong) are respectively engulfed in internet controversies!

programme.title: Heart And Greed
programme.desc: LING LAI-YING (Louise Lee) and her husband WONG WING-CHING (Ha Yu) work hard to run their restaurant, eventually turning it into an entrepreneurial success involving real estate investing and business. LAI-YING's younger brother LING SHING-FUNG (Bosco Wong) even tries to help them get the company listed on the stock market. Initially, WING-CHING does not agree with this. After seeing the century old family print business run by his benefactor HUI NGA-LUN (Joseph Lee), who helped him get acquitted of a charge years ago, on the verge of bankruptcy, WING-CHING agrees to SHING-FUNG's proposal by merging the two families' businesses for mutual benefit. However, WING-CHING's sister-in-law LEUNG SHUN-WAH (Susanna Kwan) and her younger brother LEUNG CHAN (Louis Yuen) are strongly opposed to the idea. Moreover, the long-standing feud between them and NGA-LUN's wife YU SAU-WAI, AMELIA (Michelle Yim) and the Hui family's self-proclaimed upper-class social status leave a very bad impression on them. Nevertheless, with LAI-YING's support, WING-CHING reaches an agreement with the Huis. Unfortunately, the social inequality between the upper and lower classes gives rise to more conflicts. On top of that, the love between the second son of the Wong family, WONG WAI-KA (Vincent Wong), and the only daughter of the Hui family, HUI BUI-YI, BELLE (Eliza Sam), has transcended obstacles, which eventually forces WAI-KA to leave. Devastated, LAI-YING is also torn by the infidelity between her eldest daughter WONG YI-OI (Sharon Chan) and a married man named CHENG LAP-ON (Michael Tong). To make things worse, LAI-YING's favorite younger brother SHING-FUNG is not himself anymore after he gets involved in an on-again, off-again relationship with his friend FONG HEI-MAN (Priscilla Wong). Soon, the two families find themselves on the brink of open hostility and a massive war for revenge is brewing……

programme.title: Lady Sour
programme.desc: CHO CHING (Myolie Wu) and her mother CHO CHO BAI-YUET (Gigi Wong) lead vagrant lives by practicing medicine everywhere, during which they get to know KAI CHUN (Ron Ng), a man with a skin disease, and their fellow villager, CHIN TUNG (Him Law), respectively. Falling in love with CHIN TUNG at first sight, CHO CHING tries by all means to marry him, unfortunately, the matriarch of the vinegar brewery, CHIN SHEUNG (Alice Chan), thwarts her plan at all costs, because she is still nursing a grudge against BAI-YUET. Having recovered from his illness, KAI CHUN comes up with an idea, successfully helping CHO CHING get what she wants. CHO CHING thinks she is able to settle down once and for all after marriage, to her surprise, CHIN TUNG loves a maid called SHAN CHA (Eliza Sum) so dearly. CHO CHING then seizes the opportunity to make a muddle of things between them, yet somehow, her action results in CHIN TUNG having a relationship with SHAN CHA. CHIN TUNG takes SHAN CHA as his concubine, which makes CHO CHING burn up with jealousy, adding fuel to the fire even more. Out of the blue, on the heels of a decomposed body being recovered, BAI-YUET is accused of having murdered her husband and sentenced to death. The CHIN family demands CHO CHING to sever ties with her mother BAI-YUET for fear of damaging their reputation. In the meantime, CHO CHING finds herself pregnant, which, however, renders her enmeshed in a divorce battle......

Falling in love with CHIN TUNG at first sight, CHO CHING tries by all means to marry him, unfortunately, the matriarch of the vinegar brewery, CHIN SHEUNG (Alice Chan), thwarts her plan at all costs, because she is still nursing a grudge against BAI-YUET. Having recovered from his illness, KAI CHUN comes up with an idea, successfully helping CHO CHING get what she wants. CHO CHING thinks she is able to settle down once and for all after marriage, to her surprise, CHIN TUNG loves a maid called SHAN CHA (Eliza Sum) so dearly. CHO CHING then seizes the opportunity to make a muddle of things between them, yet somehow, her action results in CHIN TUNG having a relationship with SHAN CHA. CHIN TUNG takes SHAN CHA as his concubine, which makes CHO CHING burn up with jealousy, adding fuel to the fire even more. Out of the blue, on the heels of a decomposed body being recovered, BAI-YUET is accused of having murdered her husband and sentenced to death. The CHIN family demands CHO CHING to sever ties with her mother BAI-YUET for fear of damaging their reputation. In the meantime, CHO CHING finds herself pregnant, which, however, renders her enmeshed in a divorce battle......

programme.title: Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: Ever since his childhood, KO TIN-PO (Wong Cho Lam) has tasted a variety of great delicacies, and he is capable of analyzing the food quality and authenticity once he tastes it. But, owing to the decline of his family, he ends up wandering on the street with his servant LEE WAI (Jack Wu), making a living from selling buns. Also due to his gourmet background, he gets to know a street performer KEI MO-SUET (Joey Meng), the most beautiful girl in Peking NIAN RUOBI (Nancy Wu) and teen celebrity chef MAI SIU-YU (Stephanie Ho), etc. As fate would have it, he comes across Prince YINZHEN (Ben Wong), who is making a tour in disguise, and the two share similar interests. Later on, he is recommended for an imperial chef in the palace, where he runs into his archrival CHOI HOK-TING (Bob Lam), resulting in consecutive fierce battles between them. Meanwhile, TIN-PO has no idea he has been caught in the plot that Prince YINSI (Louis Cheung) hatches to become the rightful heir to the throne. Under such disadvantage, TIN-PO becomes the man who brings luck to Prince YINZHEN, continuously turning the tide for him before his defeat. However, an unexpected betrothal brings him down from the lofty position to the most inferior one of a stray dog......

programme.title: Offliners, The
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, investing in finance, real estate and commerce are down-to-earth activities, but rich heiress WONG CHI-FEI (Katy Kung) prefers getting her head in the clouds, cofounding a start-up technology company with her best friend HUI CHING-WAI (Jason Chan). A network hacking incident allows CHI-FEI to have a chance to know how capable IT genius DING SHUN-HEI (Owen Cheung) is, so she invites him to join the company. SHUN-HEI is a geek and oblivious of his surroundings. He gets help from a nurse named CHEUNG LOI (Moon Lau) and overcomes his communication barriers. Gradually, he grows fond of her. Despite initial disagreements, CHI-FEI and SHUN-HEI become more cooperative and are even complementary to each other. Inadvertently, CHI-FEI develops feelings for SHUN-HEI…… Originally, CHI-FEI believes that technology is making the world a better place, however, her father WONG SAU-KEN (Joseph Lee), younger brother WONG CHI-LUNG (Marcus Lo) and SHUN-HEI's younger sister DING SHUN-YAN (Jacqueline Wong) are respectively engulfed in internet controversies!

programme.title: Heart And Greed
programme.desc: LING LAI-YING (Louise Lee) and her husband WONG WING-CHING (Ha Yu) work hard to run their restaurant, eventually turning it into an entrepreneurial success involving real estate investing and business. LAI-YING's younger brother LING SHING-FUNG (Bosco Wong) even tries to help them get the company listed on the stock market. Initially, WING-CHING does not agree with this. After seeing the century old family print business run by his benefactor HUI NGA-LUN (Joseph Lee), who helped him get acquitted of a charge years ago, on the verge of bankruptcy, WING-CHING agrees to SHING-FUNG's proposal by merging the two families' businesses for mutual benefit. However, WING-CHING's sister-in-law LEUNG SHUN-WAH (Susanna Kwan) and her younger brother LEUNG CHAN (Louis Yuen) are strongly opposed to the idea. Moreover, the long-standing feud between them and NGA-LUN's wife YU SAU-WAI, AMELIA (Michelle Yim) and the Hui family's self-proclaimed upper-class social status leave a very bad impression on them. Nevertheless, with LAI-YING's support, WING-CHING reaches an agreement with the Huis. Unfortunately, the social inequality between the upper and lower classes gives rise to more conflicts. On top of that, the love between the second son of the Wong family, WONG WAI-KA (Vincent Wong), and the only daughter of the Hui family, HUI BUI-YI, BELLE (Eliza Sam), has transcended obstacles, which eventually forces WAI-KA to leave. Devastated, LAI-YING is also torn by the infidelity between her eldest daughter WONG YI-OI (Sharon Chan) and a married man named CHENG LAP-ON (Michael Tong). To make things worse, LAI-YING's favorite younger brother SHING-FUNG is not himself anymore after he gets involved in an on-again, off-again relationship with his friend FONG HEI-MAN (Priscilla Wong). Soon, the two families find themselves on the brink of open hostility and a massive war for revenge is brewing……

Meanwhile, TIN-PO has no idea he has been caught in the plot that Prince YINSI (Louis Cheung) hatches to become the rightful heir to the throne. Under such disadvantage, TIN-PO becomes the man who brings luck to Prince YINZHEN, continuously turning the tide for him before his defeat. However, an unexpected betrothal brings him down from the lofty position to the most inferior one of a stray dog......

programme.title: Offliners, The
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, investing in finance, real estate and commerce are down-to-earth activities, but rich heiress WONG CHI-FEI (Katy Kung) prefers getting her head in the clouds, cofounding a start-up technology company with her best friend HUI CHING-WAI (Jason Chan). A network hacking incident allows CHI-FEI to have a chance to know how capable IT genius DING SHUN-HEI (Owen Cheung) is, so she invites him to join the company. SHUN-HEI is a geek and oblivious of his surroundings. He gets help from a nurse named CHEUNG LOI (Moon Lau) and overcomes his communication barriers. Gradually, he grows fond of her. Despite initial disagreements, CHI-FEI and SHUN-HEI become more cooperative and are even complementary to each other. Inadvertently, CHI-FEI develops feelings for SHUN-HEI…… Originally, CHI-FEI believes that technology is making the world a better place, however, her father WONG SAU-KEN (Joseph Lee), younger brother WONG CHI-LUNG (Marcus Lo) and SHUN-HEI's younger sister DING SHUN-YAN (Jacqueline Wong) are respectively engulfed in internet controversies!

programme.title: Heart And Greed
programme.desc: LING LAI-YING (Louise Lee) and her husband WONG WING-CHING (Ha Yu) work hard to run their restaurant, eventually turning it into an entrepreneurial success involving real estate investing and business. LAI-YING's younger brother LING SHING-FUNG (Bosco Wong) even tries to help them get the company listed on the stock market. Initially, WING-CHING does not agree with this. After seeing the century old family print business run by his benefactor HUI NGA-LUN (Joseph Lee), who helped him get acquitted of a charge years ago, on the verge of bankruptcy, WING-CHING agrees to SHING-FUNG's proposal by merging the two families' businesses for mutual benefit. However, WING-CHING's sister-in-law LEUNG SHUN-WAH (Susanna Kwan) and her younger brother LEUNG CHAN (Louis Yuen) are strongly opposed to the idea. Moreover, the long-standing feud between them and NGA-LUN's wife YU SAU-WAI, AMELIA (Michelle Yim) and the Hui family's self-proclaimed upper-class social status leave a very bad impression on them. Nevertheless, with LAI-YING's support, WING-CHING reaches an agreement with the Huis. Unfortunately, the social inequality between the upper and lower classes gives rise to more conflicts. On top of that, the love between the second son of the Wong family, WONG WAI-KA (Vincent Wong), and the only daughter of the Hui family, HUI BUI-YI, BELLE (Eliza Sam), has transcended obstacles, which eventually forces WAI-KA to leave. Devastated, LAI-YING is also torn by the infidelity between her eldest daughter WONG YI-OI (Sharon Chan) and a married man named CHENG LAP-ON (Michael Tong). To make things worse, LAI-YING's favorite younger brother SHING-FUNG is not himself anymore after he gets involved in an on-again, off-again relationship with his friend FONG HEI-MAN (Priscilla Wong). Soon, the two families find themselves on the brink of open hostility and a massive war for revenge is brewing……

programme.title: Lady Sour
programme.desc: CHO CHING (Myolie Wu) and her mother CHO CHO BAI-YUET (Gigi Wong) lead vagrant lives by practicing medicine everywhere, during which they get to know KAI CHUN (Ron Ng), a man with a skin disease, and their fellow villager, CHIN TUNG (Him Law), respectively. Falling in love with CHIN TUNG at first sight, CHO CHING tries by all means to marry him, unfortunately, the matriarch of the vinegar brewery, CHIN SHEUNG (Alice Chan), thwarts her plan at all costs, because she is still nursing a grudge against BAI-YUET. Having recovered from his illness, KAI CHUN comes up with an idea, successfully helping CHO CHING get what she wants. CHO CHING thinks she is able to settle down once and for all after marriage, to her surprise, CHIN TUNG loves a maid called SHAN CHA (Eliza Sum) so dearly. CHO CHING then seizes the opportunity to make a muddle of things between them, yet somehow, her action results in CHIN TUNG having a relationship with SHAN CHA. CHIN TUNG takes SHAN CHA as his concubine, which makes CHO CHING burn up with jealousy, adding fuel to the fire even more. Out of the blue, on the heels of a decomposed body being recovered, BAI-YUET is accused of having murdered her husband and sentenced to death. The CHIN family demands CHO CHING to sever ties with her mother BAI-YUET for fear of damaging their reputation. In the meantime, CHO CHING finds herself pregnant, which, however, renders her enmeshed in a divorce battle......

programme.title: Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUNG (So Yuk Wa, Louisa) to control TIGER and misleads LEUNG that TIGER is her long lost rescuer. Using tricks to upset TIGER, he makes TIGER marry LEUNG. Since then, LEUNG tries every means to domesticate her husband and that almost drives him insane. BUN is relieved to escape from TIGER's manipulation but he carelessly causes lots of troubles elsewhere… “A Bride for A Ride” brings you a modern perspective of this traditional tale and you'll surely be surprised with its astonishing approach.

programme.title: Married But Available
programme.desc: An unexpected event leads couple Ouyang Zicong and Zhu Mingming to decide to get married. However, to avoid offending her boss, Shi Lujia, Mingming has to conceal her marital status. Meanwhile, Zicong is invited by his college classmate Zhang Zhanbo to join Lujia's company, plotting to reclaim the gold business founded by Zhanbo's father, Zhang Jianguo. The secretly married couple are forced into conflict within the company, gradually developing misunderstandings. Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingming discover they are destined for each other, and Ji Wenyi, who has secretly loved Zicong for over ten years, also tempts him, leading to extramarital affairs for both. After Mingming decides to separate, Zicong discovers Zhanbo's business scheme and tries to stop him, further alienating Mingming. Will their relationship take a turn for the better?

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage. Siu shockingly finds out Alex is a mirage! Welcome to the 1960s and Coco (Selena Lee) is a hostess at Twilight Ballroom. She dreams of becoming an air hostess someday. She falls in love with Lau Yuk-fai (Joel Chan), who is a policeman and a dead ringer for some guy in her dream. programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his eyes. According to BAO ZHENG's investigation, SEUNG-SEUNG was actually a princess, but was instead framed by a villain, GAO JIAN (Ben Wong). Shedding his tears, BAO ZHENG is forced to execute SEUNG-SEUNG, triggering his soul to once again float out of his body to the 1950s, when he becomes an all-powerful inspector WAH LUNG-BIU (Bobby Au Yeung). As predestined, he believes he will re-encounter TSIK-SUET, yet TIN TSAU-FUNG (Esther Kwan), who is standing in front of him, does not recall him at all. Unexpectedly, he learns that a dancer, LAM YIM-FONG (Rebecca Zhu) and her boyfriend YUEN KWAI (Pierre Ngo), are his biological parents. Moreover, TIN TSAU-FUNG's younger sister TIN TSAU-NGAN (Mandy Wong) turns out to be manipulating the whole plot. Tragedy recurs when LUNG-BIU accidentally kills TSAU-FUNG again. However, to his surprise, it is him initiating all these tragedies......

programme.title: Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUNG (So Yuk Wa, Louisa) to control TIGER and misleads LEUNG that TIGER is her long lost rescuer. Using tricks to upset TIGER, he makes TIGER marry LEUNG. Since then, LEUNG tries every means to domesticate her husband and that almost drives him insane. BUN is relieved to escape from TIGER's manipulation but he carelessly causes lots of troubles elsewhere… “A Bride for A Ride” brings you a modern perspective of this traditional tale and you'll surely be surprised with its astonishing approach.

programme.title: Married But Available
programme.desc: An unexpected event leads couple Ouyang Zicong and Zhu Mingming to decide to get married. However, to avoid offending her boss, Shi Lujia, Mingming has to conceal her marital status. Meanwhile, Zicong is invited by his college classmate Zhang Zhanbo to join Lujia's company, plotting to reclaim the gold business founded by Zhanbo's father, Zhang Jianguo. The secretly married couple are forced into conflict within the company, gradually developing misunderstandings. Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingming discover they are destined for each other, and Ji Wenyi, who has secretly loved Zicong for over ten years, also tempts him, leading to extramarital affairs for both. After Mingming decides to separate, Zicong discovers Zhanbo's business scheme and tries to stop him, further alienating Mingming. Will their relationship take a turn for the better?

programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his eyes. According to BAO ZHENG's investigation, SEUNG-SEUNG was actually a princess, but was instead framed by a villain, GAO JIAN (Ben Wong). Shedding his tears, BAO ZHENG is forced to execute SEUNG-SEUNG, triggering his soul to once again float out of his body to the 1950s, when he becomes an all-powerful inspector WAH LUNG-BIU (Bobby Au Yeung). As predestined, he believes he will re-encounter TSIK-SUET, yet TIN TSAU-FUNG (Esther Kwan), who is standing in front of him, does not recall him at all. On the contrary, she thinks he is the one who killed her husband. In order to change his fate, LUNG-BIU continuously verifies the truth. Unexpectedly, he learns that a dancer, LAM YIM-FONG (Rebecca Zhu) and her boyfriend YUEN KWAI (Pierre Ngo), are his biological parents. Moreover, TIN TSAU-FUNG's younger sister TIN TSAU-NGAN (Mandy Wong) turns out to be manipulating the whole plot. Tragedy recurs when LUNG-BIU accidentally kills TSAU-FUNG again. With KAM-CHEONG's soul returning to the modern era, he is determined to ferret out the one who has cast the spell on him in the cycle of reincarnation so as to protect TSIK-SUET as well as to escape from the curse. However, to his surprise, it is him initiating all these tragedies......

programme.title: Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUNG (So Yuk Wa, Louisa) to control TIGER and misleads LEUNG that TIGER is her long lost rescuer. Using tricks to upset TIGER, he makes TIGER marry LEUNG. Since then, LEUNG tries every means to domesticate her husband and that almost drives him insane. BUN is relieved to escape from TIGER's manipulation but he carelessly causes lots of troubles elsewhere… “A Bride for A Ride” brings you a modern perspective of this traditional tale and you'll surely be surprised with its astonishing approach.

programme.title: Married But Available
programme.desc: An unexpected event leads couple Ouyang Zicong and Zhu Mingming to decide to get married. However, to avoid offending her boss, Shi Lujia, Mingming has to conceal her marital status. Meanwhile, Zicong is invited by his college classmate Zhang Zhanbo to join Lujia's company, plotting to reclaim the gold business founded by Zhanbo's father, Zhang Jianguo. The secretly married couple are forced into conflict within the company, gradually developing misunderstandings. Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingming discover they are destined for each other, and Ji Wenyi, who has secretly loved Zicong for over ten years, also tempts him, leading to extramarital affairs for both. After Mingming decides to separate, Zicong discovers Zhanbo's business scheme and tries to stop him, further alienating Mingming. Will their relationship take a turn for the better?

programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his eyes. According to BAO ZHENG's investigation, SEUNG-SEUNG was actually a princess, but was instead framed by a villain, GAO JIAN (Ben Wong). Shedding his tears, BAO ZHENG is forced to execute SEUNG-SEUNG, triggering his soul to once again float out of his body to the 1950s, when he becomes an all-powerful inspector WAH LUNG-BIU (Bobby Au Yeung). As predestined, he believes he will re-encounter TSIK-SUET, yet TIN TSAU-FUNG (Esther Kwan), who is standing in front of him, does not recall him at all. On the contrary, she thinks he is the one who killed her husband. In order to change his fate, LUNG-BIU continuously verifies the truth. Unexpectedly, he learns that a dancer, LAM YIM-FONG (Rebecca Zhu) and her boyfriend YUEN KWAI (Pierre Ngo), are his biological parents. Moreover, TIN TSAU-FUNG's younger sister TIN TSAU-NGAN (Mandy Wong) turns out to be manipulating the whole plot. Tragedy recurs when LUNG-BIU accidentally kills TSAU-FUNG again. With KAM-CHEONG's soul returning to the modern era, he is determined to ferret out the one who has cast the spell on him in the cycle of reincarnation so as to protect TSIK-SUET as well as to escape from the curse. However, to his surprise, it is him initiating all these tragedies......

With KAM-CHEONG's soul returning to the modern era, he is determined to ferret out the one who has cast the spell on him in the cycle of reincarnation so as to protect TSIK-SUET as well as to escape from the curse. However, to his surprise, it is him initiating all these tragedies......

programme.title: Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUNG (So Yuk Wa, Louisa) to control TIGER and misleads LEUNG that TIGER is her long lost rescuer. Using tricks to upset TIGER, he makes TIGER marry LEUNG. Since then, LEUNG tries every means to domesticate her husband and that almost drives him insane. BUN is relieved to escape from TIGER's manipulation but he carelessly causes lots of troubles elsewhere… “A Bride for A Ride” brings you a modern perspective of this traditional tale and you'll surely be surprised with its astonishing approach.

programme.title: Married But Available
programme.desc: An unexpected event leads couple Ouyang Zicong and Zhu Mingming to decide to get married. However, to avoid offending her boss, Shi Lujia, Mingming has to conceal her marital status. Meanwhile, Zicong is invited by his college classmate Zhang Zhanbo to join Lujia's company, plotting to reclaim the gold business founded by Zhanbo's father, Zhang Jianguo. The secretly married couple are forced into conflict within the company, gradually developing misunderstandings. Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingming discover they are destined for each other, and Ji Wenyi, who has secretly loved Zicong for over ten years, also tempts him, leading to extramarital affairs for both. After Mingming decides to separate, Zicong discovers Zhanbo's business scheme and tries to stop him, further alienating Mingming. Will their relationship take a turn for the better?

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage. Siu shockingly finds out Alex is a mirage! Welcome to the 1960s and Coco (Selena Lee) is a hostess at Twilight Ballroom. She dreams of becoming an air hostess someday. She falls in love with Lau Yuk-fai (Joel Chan), who is a policeman and a dead ringer for some guy in her dream. Her fantastic dream is even adapted as a novel by bookstore owner Lam Yeuk-sze (Bob Cheung). Siu accidentally finds this novel from yesteryear as he just has to get to the bottom of the mystery. Siu is aghast when he finds out he and Alex had been destined to get intertwined in some previous life.

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN's bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG's lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI's (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne of MAN. FUNG loses his memory on a mission and has turned from a cruel person into a man with sympathy. PRINCESS WING-YEUNG (Elanne Kwong) never likes brocade guards. She tells PO, a good friend of hers, to guard against FUNG. MAN still thinks very highly of FUNG, but FUNG has become distrustful since his accident. And for reason he does not know, he finds the mysterious SHUM TSIN-SAM (Kate Tsui) and TAI, who is a deep person, very familiar. Later when he comes to know a secret on a mission to kill TAI, he is caught in a dilemma of feeling angry and guilty.

programme.title: Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: Ever since his childhood, KO TIN-PO (Wong Cho Lam) has tasted a variety of great delicacies, and he is capable of analyzing the food quality and authenticity once he tastes it. But, owing to the decline of his family, he ends up wandering on the street with his servant LEE WAI (Jack Wu), making a living from selling buns. Also due to his gourmet background, he gets to know a street performer KEI MO-SUET (Joey Meng), the most beautiful girl in Peking NIAN RUOBI (Nancy Wu) and teen celebrity chef MAI SIU-YU (Stephanie Ho), etc. As fate would have it, he comes across Prince YINZHEN (Ben Wong), who is making a tour in disguise, and the two share similar interests. Later on, he is recommended for an imperial chef in the palace, where he runs into his archrival CHOI HOK-TING (Bob Lam), resulting in consecutive fierce battles between them. Meanwhile, TIN-PO has no idea he has been caught in the plot that Prince YINSI (Louis Cheung) hatches to become the rightful heir to the throne. Under such disadvantage, TIN-PO becomes the man who brings luck to Prince YINZHEN, continuously turning the tide for him before his defeat. However, an unexpected betrothal brings him down from the lofty position to the most inferior one of a stray dog......

programme.title: Offliners, The
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, investing in finance, real estate and commerce are down-to-earth activities, but rich heiress WONG CHI-FEI (Katy Kung) prefers getting her head in the clouds, cofounding a start-up technology company with her best friend HUI CHING-WAI (Jason Chan). A network hacking incident allows CHI-FEI to have a chance to know how capable IT genius DING SHUN-HEI (Owen Cheung) is, so she invites him to join the company. SHUN-HEI is a geek and oblivious of his surroundings. He gets help from a nurse named CHEUNG LOI (Moon Lau) and overcomes his communication barriers. Gradually, he grows fond of her. Despite initial disagreements, CHI-FEI and SHUN-HEI become more cooperative and are even complementary to each other. Inadvertently, CHI-FEI develops feelings for SHUN-HEI…… Originally, CHI-FEI believes that technology is making the world a better place, however, her father WONG SAU-KEN (Joseph Lee), younger brother WONG CHI-LUNG (Marcus Lo) and SHUN-HEI's younger sister DING SHUN-YAN (Jacqueline Wong) are respectively engulfed in internet controversies!

programme.title: Heart And Greed
programme.desc: LING LAI-YING (Louise Lee) and her husband WONG WING-CHING (Ha Yu) work hard to run their restaurant, eventually turning it into an entrepreneurial success involving real estate investing and business. LAI-YING's younger brother LING SHING-FUNG (Bosco Wong) even tries to help them get the company listed on the stock market. Initially, WING-CHING does not agree with this. After seeing the century old family print business run by his benefactor HUI NGA-LUN (Joseph Lee), who helped him get acquitted of a charge years ago, on the verge of bankruptcy, WING-CHING agrees to SHING-FUNG's proposal by merging the two families' businesses for mutual benefit. However, WING-CHING's sister-in-law LEUNG SHUN-WAH (Susanna Kwan) and her younger brother LEUNG CHAN (Louis Yuen) are strongly opposed to the idea. Moreover, the long-standing feud between them and NGA-LUN's wife YU SAU-WAI, AMELIA (Michelle Yim) and the Hui family's self-proclaimed upper-class social status leave a very bad impression on them. Nevertheless, with LAI-YING's support, WING-CHING reaches an agreement with the Huis. Unfortunately, the social inequality between the upper and lower classes gives rise to more conflicts. On top of that, the love between the second son of the Wong family, WONG WAI-KA (Vincent Wong), and the only daughter of the Hui family, HUI BUI-YI, BELLE (Eliza Sam), has transcended obstacles, which eventually forces WAI-KA to leave. Devastated, LAI-YING is also torn by the infidelity between her eldest daughter WONG YI-OI (Sharon Chan) and a married man named CHENG LAP-ON (Michael Tong). To make things worse, LAI-YING's favorite younger brother SHING-FUNG is not himself anymore after he gets involved in an on-again, off-again relationship with his friend FONG HEI-MAN (Priscilla Wong). Soon, the two families find themselves on the brink of open hostility and a massive war for revenge is brewing……

programme.title: Lady Sour
programme.desc: CHO CHING (Myolie Wu) and her mother CHO CHO BAI-YUET (Gigi Wong) lead vagrant lives by practicing medicine everywhere, during which they get to know KAI CHUN (Ron Ng), a man with a skin disease, and their fellow villager, CHIN TUNG (Him Law), respectively. Falling in love with CHIN TUNG at first sight, CHO CHING tries by all means to marry him, unfortunately, the matriarch of the vinegar brewery, CHIN SHEUNG (Alice Chan), thwarts her plan at all costs, because she is still nursing a grudge against BAI-YUET. Having recovered from his illness, KAI CHUN comes up with an idea, successfully helping CHO CHING get what she wants. CHO CHING thinks she is able to settle down once and for all after marriage, to her surprise, CHIN TUNG loves a maid called SHAN CHA (Eliza Sum) so dearly. CHO CHING then seizes the opportunity to make a muddle of things between them, yet somehow, her action results in CHIN TUNG having a relationship with SHAN CHA. CHIN TUNG takes SHAN CHA as his concubine, which makes CHO CHING burn up with jealousy, adding fuel to the fire even more. Out of the blue, on the heels of a decomposed body being recovered, BAI-YUET is accused of having murdered her husband and sentenced to death. The CHIN family demands CHO CHING to sever ties with her mother BAI-YUET for fear of damaging their reputation. In the meantime, CHO CHING finds herself pregnant, which, however, renders her enmeshed in a divorce battle......

Meanwhile, TIN-PO has no idea he has been caught in the plot that Prince YINSI (Louis Cheung) hatches to become the rightful heir to the throne. Under such disadvantage, TIN-PO becomes the man who brings luck to Prince YINZHEN, continuously turning the tide for him before his defeat. However, an unexpected betrothal brings him down from the lofty position to the most inferior one of a stray dog......

programme.title: Chun Hui
programme.desc: Chun Hui (Spring Sunshine) tells the epic, true story of Ge Jianhao, a legendary "revolutionary mother." The drama follows her inspiring journey as she leads her children away from their small hometown to major Chinese cities, and eventually all the way to France. Driven by a lifelong search for truth, her entire family ultimately dedicates and sacrifices their lives to fight for the communist cause.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu & his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: The show 'Top Singers' aims to spotlight outstanding Taiwanese singers and composers, setting a new standard in the industry. Combining elements of competition, variety, and personal stories, the show welcomes participants of all ages. Its goals include discovering grassroots talent, innovating Taiwanese song performance styles, and involving more local talent in song composition to infuse new life into Taiwanese music.

Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: This film celebrates the 25th anniversary of Hong Kong's Handover in a series of four cultural stories about young Hong Kongers from different walks of life: a young man with autism pursuing his dream, a reconciliation between father and son, a Chinese opera star helping young pop singers, and a Nepali youth becoming a professional lion dancer.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into "haunted flats", which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Last Suspect
programme.desc: Lawyer Chen receives a mysterious call demanding her to defend a murder suspect after her daughter is kidnapped, and is told that she can only save her daughter by winning the case. As she starts investigation with the police and evidence emerges, Chen discovers the truth and reveals the mastermind. Can she rescue her daughter in time?

programme.title: To Live and Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: Fai (Nick Cheung), a legendary triad figure, was convicted and sent to prison for slaughtering a bunch of people. 30 years later, with the help of a social worker (Chan Lai Wan), Fai release from prison, the city of Mongkok has totally changed and he has almost forgotten his way back home. Disoriented and trapped in the notorious town of vices, Fai must find his way out of a life with a mother suffering from Alzheimer's disease (Paw Hee Ching), a hooker girlfriend (Mo Xiaoqi) with her mentally-challenged younger sister (Natalie Meng), and a malicious cop (Liu Kai Chi) hot on his tail.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma takes on a perilous escort mission across the desert to Chang'an. His charge is the empire's most wanted man, drawing pursuit from all sides. As rival forces close in, Dao Ma is pulled into a conspiracy that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Three bizarre tales intertwine in this horror satire set against the housing crisis of Hong Kong, where soaring property prices have driven dwellers to take every insane effort necessary to secure a cramped space, even if it means sharing the same roof with the dead!

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A killer and a stage actor accidentally swapped their identities at a bathhouse. The actor must complete the killer's mission while the killer thinks he is a hopeless actor after losing his memory during the accident. When the killer strives to become a successful stage actor, he also starts to recall what has happened…

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional car racer, Le falls into despair after causing his brother's death in a car race, until he meets female doctor Hui and becomes an ambulance driver who vows to “save lives with speed”. Meanwhile, the truth about his brother's accident emerges with the investigation of Le's three good friends...

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and lives a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owner's deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with Nan since she met him once as a child. After graduating high school, Zhi realizes that she and Nan are in the same university, where they get to know each other by chance and become close friends. However, Zhi is still too shy to express her love for Nan. Will this long-term crush finally turn into true love?

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: Chi is a property agent who leads an aimless and unfulfilling life until he reunites with his P.E. teacher, Wong, from primary school. Despite his illness, Wong insists on keeping his promise of completing a 10K marathon to his late wife. Inspired by Wong, Chi brings himself to his feet and finds the courage to cheer himself on!

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: Chao Yang and Zi Hong are soon to wed but both have not met the other's parents. When a client requests for a livestream of their reunion dinner to promote his products, it set the stage for their parents' first meeting. Estranged from his mother, Yang decides to rent a family for the dinner which results in a series of mishaps and hilarity.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Adapted from true events, Fraudster Dai swindled countless victims across China before vanishing without a trace. Seven years later, he resurfaces in Paris. Led by Detective Ye Jun, the Chinese Fox Hunt Team launches a high-stakes cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the pursuit.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad-tempered and lives alone. His forced retirement, failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter have left him in despair, prompting him to consider ending his life. Fortunately, he is rescued by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate.

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over the death of her young son by becoming a foster parent. For 13 years, Mei's dedication to the foster child leads her to neglect her husband and the true needs of the child. It is only through the child's unintentional help that the couple finally manages to salvage their relationship.

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era: a pregnant woman haunted by a ghost sacrifices her life to save her baby; a boy commits suicide after being bullied by four medical students and his spirit returns for revenge; some company staff are haunted after they open a box of used clothes, releasing a more than 20-year resentment.

programme.title: WE12
programme.desc: An underground organization, “The League of Kaito” has been maintaining international order. While 12 elite members possess extraordinary skills and have worked independently for a period of time, they must rekindle their long-lost team spirit to accomplish a mission together to save the world from disaster.

programme.title: MuMu
programme.desc: Mumu, a cheerful seven-year-old girl, lives with her deaf father in a deaf community and connects him to the outside world. However, their peaceful life is disrupted when her estranged mother reappears, pushing Mumu into the hearing world. Meanwhile, her father becomes ensnared by a gang that exploits the deaf to commit crimes.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: Facing skyrocketing rent and dwindling customers, a middle-aged internet café owner assembles a ragtag team for a HK$500,000 eSports tournament. He recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a dismissed pro gamer. What follows is an impossible battle—one that finally lets these dreamers fight with no regrets.

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee sparks a Tang Dynasty “Mission Impossible”! Low-ranking official Li Shan De must deliver it a thousand miles in three days to satisfy a consort's craving. Racing against time, he encounters obstacles and absurd demands, turning the journey into a satirical adventure filled with tension and unexpected twists.

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional car racer, Le falls into despair after causing his brother's death in a car race, until he meets female doctor Hui and becomes an ambulance driver who vows to “save lives with speed”. Meanwhile, the truth about his brother's accident emerges with the investigation of Le's three good friends...

programme.title: It's A Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: CJ7
programme.desc: Stephen Chow returns in this hilarious and heartwarming tale of a father and son who discover an adorable alien in the trash.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Xiao Fei is a cheerful girl who has been abandoned by her mother. One day, she encounters a gifted young man named Zi Wai, who is battling a rare disease. Determined to help him, she embarks on a journey to find his lost love. Even when they discover that the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into "haunted flats", which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: In a world where humans have ceased to dream, a monster drifts through the fading illusions of the dreamworld. Clinging to visions no one else can see, its solitude is interrupted by a woman uniquely gifted to perceive these hidden dreams. Choosing to step into the monster's dreams, she seeks the truth that lies hidden within.

programme.title: The Brotherhood Of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his childhood friend Meow flee Hong Kong after discovering that Meow attempted to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, Chai becomes a key member of the triad. When he runs into Meow one day, he knows that his gang will kill Meow if they find him. Caught between triad and brotherhood, what will Chai choose?

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, a white woman is murdered in Chinatown, and a Chinese man becomes the prime suspect. The crime sparks public outcry to shut down the district. Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: The White Storm 3 Heaven Or Hell
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Billy works undercover in Suchat's drug cartel, while another undercover cop Wing successfully earns their trust in an incident and a brotherly bond is built among the three. When the police busts the syndicate, Suchat flees to the Golden Triangle with Billy and receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust…

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba is forced to work at home during COVID-19 and fights with his family every day. He decides to turn his mother's chilli sauce into a trendy commodity to keep his family occupied.
